//_FIXED: Bug #1: MIN_CONFLUENCE_SCORE was hardcoded in App.tsx AND unreachable because signalEngine.ts capped at 60. Rebalanced in engine_config + signalEngine reweight. See CHANGELOG at bottom.
//_NEW_BLOCKS_NOTE: These blocks are additive. Existing code that doesn't read them is unaffected.

engine_config.//_purpose: BUG #1 FIX — single source of truth for signal engine tunables
engine_config.//_min_confluence_score: Passing threshold. signalEngine.scoreConfluence now returns up to 100 (was effectively ~60).
engine_config.//_max_atr_pct: Reject symbols whose 5m ATR% exceeds this (violent regime). Decimal — 0.02 = 2.0%.
engine_config.//_default_min_atr_pct: Fallback ATR floor for symbols not listed in min_atr_pct_by_symbol.

confluence_weights.//_purpose: Documentation of signalEngine.scoreConfluence weights. Sum = 100 per direction.

engine_config.//_weekly_direction_lock: When true, both longs and shorts are blocked on the same symbol.

scan_guard.//_purpose: BUG #3 FIX — prevents duplicate scan execution
scan_guard.//_min_gap_ms: Minimum milliseconds between two scan starts (even if first finished).
scan_guard.//_generation_tracking_enabled: If a newer scan starts, older async runs abort mid-flight.
scan_guard.//_background_interval_ms: How often the background scanner checks (only fires inside 15m close window).
scan_guard.//_manual_scan_cooldown_ms: Debounce for FORCE SCAN button clicks.

network_resilience.//_purpose: BUG #7 + BUG #8 FIX — retry policy and kill-switch gating
network_resilience.//_balance_stale_ms: Balance older than this triggers a refresh before scanning.
network_resilience.//_offline_kill_threshold_ms: 10 min. Kill switch only trips after this much time offline.
network_resilience.//_offline_kill_streak_min: AND at least this many consecutive network failures.
network_resilience.//_treat_5xx_as_network: BUG #8 FIX — Binance 5xx is NOT counted as network loss.
network_resilience.//_reconcile_interval_ms: 3 min. Reconciliation safety net for missed SL/TP fills.

feature_flags.//_purpose: Toggle switches that were previously hardcoded const in App.tsx
feature_flags.//_use_adaptive_atr: When true, atrThresholds.ts percentile logic is preferred over the static map. Reserved for future.
feature_flags.//_verbose_rejection_logging: BUG #5 FIX — log every rejection reason for every symbol.

position_sizing.//_purpose: Documentation only — actual values live in App.tsx constants.
position_sizing.//_cooldown_after_sl_ms: 1 hour per-symbol lockout after a stop-loss fill.

time_stop.//_purpose: Documentation only — how long an unprofitable trade is allowed to sit.
time_stop.//_rule: Close trade if age ≥ time_stop_ms AND min_pnl ≤ pnl ≤ max_pnl (a dead trade).

safety_layers.//_purpose: Human-readable checklist — mirrors the Settings page safety list.

logging.//_purpose: BUG #5 FIX — what gets printed to the console.

CHANGELOG.//_purpose: Trace of what each fix in the recent rebuild changed.

bug_1_min_confluence_unreachable.fix: Rebalanced 6 weights (sum=100) so a passing 70 is reachable.

bug_2_duplicate_atr_map.fix: MIN_ATR_PCT_BY_SYMBOL now lives only in signalEngine.ts. App imports it.

bug_3_duplicate_scans.fix: Mutex + generation counter. Only one scan runs at a time.

bug_4_daily_cap_reset.fix: Dedicated IndexedDB/localStorage store. No more signals-dependent reset.

bug_5_silent_rejections.fix: Every symbol logs WHY it was skipped.

bug_6_trailing_stop_not_persisted.fix: Atomic updates via single Map<string, Partial<TradeSignal>> then one setSignals call.

bug_8_kill_switch_on_5xx.fix: 5xx is retryable but NOT counted as network loss. Kill switch needs both time AND streak.
